reference: Display Step 2 shared Reader construction; Step 1 controls, aliases and vertical metrics preserved
reason: Retiring the 0.25 fork adopts existing Reader 0.28 width/bearing refinements. These 20 original glyph advances per cut are the only previous advances changed; new numeric/mark/Latin glyphs inherit the shared builder metrics.

reasons.reader-028-a-width: Reader 0.28 narrowed the upright a source width from 420 to 395. Its six original accented derivatives inherit that width through their base glyph.
reasons.reader-028-e-width: Reader 0.28 narrowed the upright e source width from 420 to 398. Its four original accented derivatives inherit that width through their base glyph.
reasons.reader-028-i-bearings: Reader 0.28 increased upright i side bearings from [66,66] to [72,72], adding 12 source units / 24 font units. Its four original accented derivatives inherit those bearings.
reasons.reader-028-e-compound: Reader 0.28 made ae/oe width follow 380 + the refined e width: 800 becomes 778 source units. The configured cut width scales this inherited difference.
reasons.reader-028-fi-component: The shared fi ligature uses the refined i component spacing from Reader 0.28, adding 12 source units / 24 font units. Its letter forms remain upright under Display oblique slant.
